name: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd
about: Ultramarine & Pigments is engaged in manufacturing and selling of Pigments, Surfactants, IT-Enabled Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) activities. The Company caters to both domestic and international markets.
keyPoints:
FY23 Revenue breakup[1]
Pigments division - 32% (vs 26% in FY22)
Surfactants division - 59% (vs 66% in FY22)
IT Division - 9% (vs 8% in FY22)
Co. is a leading supplier of surfactants to South India-based FMCG players. It also manufactures detergent under the brand name OOB[2][3]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 23.3%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 7.89% over last 3 years.
